title: Senate OKs Asean extradition treaty, tourist safety bill on 3rd reading

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate on Monday approved on third and final reading three measures seeking to strengthen regional cooperation against transnational crimes, improve tourist safety, and provide free housing through usufruct arrangements. First approved was Proposed Senate Resolution No. 623, or the resolution concurring in the ratification of the Association on Southeast Asian Nations
